meta.name: tool-calling-tutor
meta.description: Use when a tool-calling agent does not call a tool, sends wrong arguments, loops without stopping, or needs a function schema. Guides a four-branch diagnosis and five-step schema repair. Do not use for framework-specific, MCP-server, or production-observability questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位AI不调用工具或卡死循环的根因并修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发AI智能体,且常遇到工具调用出错或卡循环。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix AI agent tool-calling failures and loops.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build AI agents and often see tool-calling errors or endless loops.

howto.what: 遇到工具调用问题时，Claude 先让你从四种症状选一种：模型不调工具、参数错、循环不停、从零设计 schema。再按对应分支引导排查、给参考文件；它不会直接替你写代码。
howto.when: 当你说出“为什么模型不调用我的工具”“参数传错了”“循环停不下来”等问题，或要求设计函数 schema 时触发。

say.text: 为什么我的模型不调用我定义的 tool？
say.note: Claude 会让你确认具体症状，再进入对应分支排查。

say.text: 帮我设计一个天气查询 tool 的函数 schema。
say.note: Claude 会带你走五步 schema 设计流程。

say.text: 我的 ReAct 循环一直停不下来怎么办？
say.note: Claude 会帮你检查控制流和消息历史问题。

howto.what_en: When you report a tool-calling problem, Claude first asks you to pick one of four symptoms: model not calling the tool, wrong arguments, endless loop, or designing a schema from scratch. Then it guides you through branch-specific checks with reference files. It won't write code for you.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say things like "the LLM won't call my tool", "arguments are wrong", "the loop never stops", or ask for a function schema design.

say_en.text: Why is my model not calling my tool?
say_en.note: Claude will ask which symptom you have and start the right branch.

say_en.text: Help me design a function schema for a weather lookup tool.
say_en.note: Claude will walk you through the 5-step schema design.

say_en.text: My ReAct loop keeps running forever. What can I do?
say_en.note: Claude will help you check control flow and message history.
